rationale: Archive Atlantica Sustainable Infrastructure plc from the North American manager-level PortCo list while preserving its company, ownership and audit history. Atlantica remains a London-headquartered global infrastructure platform with material operations in Europe and South America, so its North American asset footprint does not make the manager-level company primarily based in or dedicated to the United States, Canada or Mexico.

evidence.purpose: Current company perimeter, headquarters, regional footprint and operating scale.
supports: Atlantica is a global multi-region infrastructure platform rather than a North America-dedicated manager-level company
The platform retains material operations outside North America

evidence.purpose: Current company history and post-take-private operating continuity.
supports: Atlantica continued as a global infrastructure company after its December 2024 take-private
